purpose: Detect ownership capture early, buy only when capture becomes price activation, hold while control remains intact, and exit when controlled inventory releases without repair.

state_machine.meaning: Potential strong inventory acquisition while fragile leverage exits.
research_evidence: Margin decreases over the eligible ownership interval
Whale Surprise Rank = cross-sectional abnormality of dBig1000; ranking only, not BUY threshold

state_machine.meaning: Acquired inventory persists through another observable stress/ownership transition; one-shot absorption is insufficient.
requirements: Ownership persistence or repeated defensive response
Weak-hand exit remains visible or has not been fully reversed

state_machine.meaning: Captured supply begins changing price formation: selling pressure no longer causes proportional price damage and marginal demand returns.
human_interpretation: New marginal demand returns before leverage becomes dominant

state_machine.meaning: Control remains intact while price is repriced by incremental demand against compressed available supply.
Crowd/liquidity demand expands while strong inventory begins moving outward.
Handoff is not repaired; strong inventory continues to leave or fails to reconcentrate.

repair_logic.failed_repair: continued distribution, fragmented, or neutral/mixed after prior Handoff

state_machine.meaning: Weak inventory may be flushed again or a new controller may emerge; lifecycle can restart.

research_primitives.ownership_level: Context only; Big400Pct/Big1000Pct are not assumed to equal strength.
research_primitives.ownership_change: Primary evidence of displacement; dBig1000 and dBig400 are interpreted by state.
research_primitives.whale_surprise_rank: Cross-sectional rank of dBig1000 within the same snapshot; WATCH prioritization only.
research_primitives.holder_memory: Repeated response under stress is more informative than static concentration.
research_primitives.supply_damage_failure: Selling pressure persists while marginal price damage falls; Bridge remains the inherited validated proxy until a separate response-function challenger is predeclared.
research_primitives.controlled_releverage: Day-level demand can return while 20-session margin stock remains below prior level; this is activation, not mania.
research_primitives.crowd_substitution: Leverage/holder demand rises while strong inventory releases; interpreted as handoff/distribution risk.

explicit_non_rules: Big400 up is not a BUY rule.
Big1000 up is not a BUY rule.
Whale Surprise Rank is not a BUY rule.
One defense event is not CONTROL.
Fixed 20/40/60-day holding is not part of V2 lifecycle execution.
Do not infer identity, beneficial owner, or manipulation intent from aggregate data.
Do not alter MONSTER V1 P97/P90/Bridge/CRL thresholds inside V1.

primary_questions: Does S1 WATCH materially increase the conditional probability of later S3 ACTIVATION versus the same eligible universe?
Does S2 CAPTURE improve precision versus S1 without destroying useful lead time?
Does S3 ACTIVATION preserve or improve MONSTER V1 post-entry 20/40/60-day behavior while entering no later on average?
Does S5->S6 RELEASE improve exit timing versus fixed horizon and versus F4 veto-only handling?
validation_plan.lead_time_metric: Trading days from first WATCH to first ACTIVATION.
validation_plan.capture_metric: Probability of repeated defensive ownership response at next eligible stress transition.
validation_plan.promotion_rule: Only if recent 3M shows stable, executable advantage with no rule relaxation; then freeze unchanged and validate 1Y.
validation_plan.failure_rule: If recent 3M does not improve lifecycle detection/execution, reject V2 and keep V1 benchmark.
